payload.title: comment thread loads existing comments
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toHaveCount(4)

Locator: getByTestId('comment-item')
Expected: 4
Received: 0

note: An empty comment thread reads like a broken empty state or an off-by-one query, but failedRequests shows the comments API request returned 502 Bad Gateway — the gateway in front of the comments service couldn't reach it, so the UI never received real data to render, not a broken empty-state path.
